<thought>We need to locate a retrosynthetic template that matches the Doebner modification (aldehyde + malonic acid → α,β‑unsaturated acid). The template should break an aldehyde functional group and a carboxylic acid (or ester) and form a C‑C double bond. We'll search the template catalog with these criteria and then retrieve the mapped reaction SMILES and template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=CC1=CC=CC=C1", 
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
